_README: Retrieval-only regression suite. Every case sets skip_faq so the curated FAQ shortcut cannot hide retrieval regressions. Establish the baseline only after reviewing three repeat runs: python eval.py --cases eval_cases_retrieval.json --baseline eval_baseline_retrieval.json --repeats 3 --update-baseline CONVERSATIONAL CASES (added 2026-09-22): cases without `new_session` inherit the previous case's session, so a pair is a two-turn conversation and ORDER MATTERS -- do not sort or reorder this list. `_role` records what each case is for and is ignored by eval.py. Added because every case here was a well-formed standalone question, so the follow-up failures this suite exists to catch could not be caught; see PENDING 'No conversational layer in the eval suite'.
